items.title: Bangladesh's foreign debt rises to $114.98 billion at end of Apr-Jun
items.description: Bangladesh's foreign debt grew by 3.65 per cent from the previous quarter to reach $114.98 billion at the end of the April-June quarter of the previous fiscal year, according to Bangladesh Bank data.
